title: TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours: Low-Balance, Auto-Replenish, Overage and Dispute Window Figures
content:
Each TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours block size sets the balance at which the client is alerted, how auto-replenishment works, what work beyond every balance costs, and how long a draw may be disputed.

| Figure | 10-Hour | 20-Hour | 40-Hour | 80-Hour | 160-Hour | 320-Hour |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Balance, percent of block hours, at or below which a low-balance notice is sent and auto-replenish fires | 20 | 20 | 20 | 15 | 10 | 10 |
| Block may be set to auto-replenish | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Most auto-replenishment orders one block may trigger | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| Rate per block hour for work beyond every available balance (overage rate, USD) | 185.00 | 180.00 | 175.00 | 170.00 | 165.00 | 160.00 |
| Block hours of overage per calendar month beyond which further non-emergency work needs the authorized contact's written approval | 5 | 10 | 20 | 40 | 80 | 160 |
| Calendar days after a draw's entry date within which the client may dispute it | 30 | 30 | 30 | 45 | 45 | 60 |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

- Low-balance point: 20 percent of a 40-hour block is 8 hours; 15 percent of an 80-hour block is 12 hours; 10 percent of a 320-hour block is 32 hours.
- Overage: 3 block hours of overage at the 80-Hour Block's rate of 170.00 is 510.00.
